description: This file appears to be a Makefile used for managing package feeds in an OpenWrt build system. It includes definitions for handling package directories, listing available feeds, and appending source entries for the opkg and apk package managers. The file also defines functions for determining package directory paths and handling ABI suffixes.

methods.name: FeedPackageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for a given package feed, considering configuration options for per-feed repositories.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendOPKG
methods.description: Appends repository source entries for the opkg package manager to a specified file.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendAPK
methods.description: Appends repository source entries for the apk package manager to a specified file.

methods.name: GetABISuffix
methods.description: Retrieves the ABI suffix for a specified package, using either a stored value or by deriving it from version information.

methods.name: FormatABISuffix
methods.description: Formats the ABI suffix based on provided version and ABI information.
